name: No-show Recovery Assistant
value_proposition: Confirm a missed appointment from one day's booking export, then draft one rebooking message with real open slots. A person reviews and sends. Nothing is sent automatically.
persona: A clinic, salon, fitness studio, or consultant with several no-shows a month.
problem: Missed appointments are lost the same day, and the rebooking message usually never gets sent. SMS consent and email consent are easy to mix up.
workflow: Write recovery rules, including statuses that are never a no-show and the repeat threshold.
Export one day's bookings and matching open slots. Remove phone numbers, email addresses, and card numbers.
Run the Confirm Attendance Prompt. Draft only when status is no_show. Skip attended and cancelled rows.
Paste the Rebooking Draft Prompt only after attendance is confirmed. Draft SMS only when sms_consent is yes and contact_pref is sms.
The person checks every confirmed field, then sends from their own tool or decides not to.
before: Staff mean to follow up on no-shows but rarely do, and slots stay empty.
after: Each confirmed miss gets one specific rebooking draft, or a visible reason not to draft, and a person decides what is sent.

guided_demo.summary: A public six-step walkthrough of one fictional booking day. It skips attended and cancelled rows, drafts one SMS for a consented no-show, holds sms_consent no, and flags a repeat no-show. Nothing is sent automatically.
steps: Show the fictional booking export and open slots, including the rule that email consent does not imply SMS consent.
Confirm attendance first. Skip attended and cancelled rows with reasons.
Draft one SMS from the Rebooking Draft Prompt using real open slots. Do not draft SMS when sms_consent is no.
Check confirmed fields against the booking row.
Flag the repeat no-show for a person to decide. Do not auto-draft it.
State that the person reviews and sends, and that nothing is sent automatically.

guided_demo.sample_output:
CONFIRMED: J. Rivera missed 10:00 Cut & color. sms_consent = yes. contact_pref = sms.
DRAFT (SMS, not sent): Hi J., we missed you today. Would Thu 14:00 or Fri 09:30 work for Cut & color?
NEEDS YOUR CHECK: R. Kim has sms_consent = no. Email consent does not imply SMS consent. Do not draft SMS.
FLAG FOR POLICY: L. Brooks reaches the repeat threshold. No recovery draft until a person decides.
Nothing is sent automatically. You review and send.
guided_demo.fictional_data_notice: The bookings, clients, and open slots on this page are fictional. Nothing here is a real customer, and nothing is sent automatically.

kit_contents.title: No-show Recovery Setup Checklist
kit_contents.purpose: Setup steps that name the Rebooking Draft Prompt and say to paste it only after attendance is confirmed.

kit_contents.title: Confirm Attendance Prompt
kit_contents.purpose: Copyable prompt that confirms attendance before any draft and treats sms_consent no the same as missing SMS consent.

kit_contents.title: Rebooking Draft Prompt
kit_contents.purpose: Copyable prompt that drafts one rebooking message with real open slots and does not treat email consent as SMS consent.

kit_contents.title: Consent and Repeat Policy Worksheet
kit_contents.purpose: Browser-only worksheet for the repeat threshold, never-a-no-show statuses, and clients to skip.

kit_contents.title: Recovery Log Template
kit_contents.purpose: CSV columns for a recovery log, including a fictional row that was drafted and not sent.

kit_contents.title: Send Review Checklist
kit_contents.purpose: Session-only checklist used before a person sends. Nothing is sent automatically.

kit_contents.title: Fictional Sample Booking Export
kit_contents.purpose: The fictional booking export used in the guided demo, including a row with email contact and sms_consent no.

kit_contents.title: Data and Safety Guidance
kit_contents.purpose: Data-handling and consent rules, including that a person approves every message and nothing is sent automatically.

decision_rules: Draft only when the booking row status is no_show.
Never treat cancelled as a no-show unless the owner removes it from the never-a-no-show list.
SMS draft only when sms_consent is yes and contact_pref is sms. sms_consent no and a missing sms_consent both mean do not draft SMS.
Email consent does not imply SMS consent.
Offer only open slots that match the missed service.
Flag repeat no-shows at the owner's threshold instead of drafting.
Nothing is sent automatically. A person reviews and sends.
human_ai_boundary: AI confirms attendance from the export. The person decides whether a no_show row is actually a miss.
AI drafts a message only after the consent and slot rules pass. The person approves every message before it goes out.
AI flags repeat no-shows. The person decides the policy.
AI never sends, books, cancels, or charges.
safety: Nothing is sent automatically. You review and send. The kit changes nothing.
Email consent does not imply SMS consent.
Do not send SMS when sms_consent is no or missing.
All demo and sample data is fictional.
The pages contain no prices or checkout.
required_data_tools: One day's booking export with time, client, service, status, contact_pref, sms_consent, and prior_no_shows
Open slots that name the service and time
acceptance_criteria: The public demo and premium kit are noindex.
The kit requires sign-in and an entitlement. Locked accounts see Premium is locked and no checkout.
Setup names the Rebooking Draft Prompt.
sms_consent no is handled the same as missing SMS consent, and email consent is not treated as SMS consent.
Nothing is sent automatically, and a person approves every message.

Live connections to Calendly, Square, Acuity, Google Calendar, Twilio, SMS, or email
